sentences.japanese: 牛は我々にミルクをくれ、鶏は卵をくれる。
sentences.english: Cows give us milk, and hens, eggs.

sentences.japanese: その鶏は最近卵を産んでいない。
sentences.english: The chicken hasn't laid any eggs lately.

sentences.japanese: この鶏は近頃ちっとも卵を産まない。
sentences.english: This hen does not lay eggs at all these days.

sentences.japanese: この鶏は近頃卵を産まない。
sentences.english: This hen does not lay eggs at all these days.

sentences.japanese: この鶏は週に何個卵を産みますか。
sentences.english: How many eggs does this hen lay each week?
